Some special effects, such as affixes or drop skills also increase the skill level. This makes it possible for the actual level of skills to exceed Lv.20.

After the skill exceeds Lv. 20, its Base Damage and the Base Damage of its Minions will no longer change. However, for every level beyond this level, this skill and its Minions will gain additional damage.
